data.desc: Cricut, Inc. is a creative platform company that makes it easy for users to create meaningful personal items. Cricut hardware and software work together as a connected platform for consumers to make beautiful, high-quality projects quickly and easily. These industry-leading products include a flagship line of smart cutting machines - the Cricut Maker family, the Cricut Explore family, and the Cricut Joy family - an extensive line of Cricut heat presses like Cricut EasyPress, the all-new Cricut StickerPix line, and a diverse collection of materials. In addition to providing products and services, Cricut fosters a thriving community of millions of dedicated users worldwide.
